description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relation and Sabaragamuwa Development -  Award made to the Industrial Dispute between Mrs. B. G. Priyani, No. 213/39 Balika Niwasa Road, Pannipitiya and Employee Trust Fund Board 1st Floor, Labour Secretariate Colombo 5
categorisation: The gazette content concerns the repudiation of an arbitrator's award under the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131). It is a legal notice published by the Commissioner General of Labour, detailing the statutory process for declaring an award ceases to have effect. This falls squarely under "Legal notices and statutory declarations" within the Legal/Regulatory category.
